description: This Java class, DefaultPolicyCommandAdapterProvider, implements the PolicyCommandAdapterProvider interface and provides various Adapter instances related to policy commands, responses, and errors used in the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter. It manages adapters for error responses, modify commands, query commands, and their respective responses, initializing them with provided header translator and error registry.

classes.name: DefaultPolicyCommandAdapterProvider
classes.description: Provides adapters for handling policy-related commands, responses, and error responses as per the PolicyCommandAdapterProvider interface. It encapsulates various adapter instances and returns them through getter methods, facilitating protocol message processing within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

methods.name: DefaultPolicyCommandAdapterProvider
methods.description: Constructor initializing adapter fields with provided error registry and header translator.

methods.name: getAdapters
methods.description: Returns a list of all Adapter instances managed by this provider for protocol processing.
